en: A colorful collage postcard featuring various scenes from Varna, Bulgaria. The images include a busy beach with many people swimming, a grand building and public square, a hotel with a classic car in front, a park entrance with columns, a view of a port with ships, and a cityscape with prominent buildings and roads. The word 'Варна' (Varna) is prominently displayed in Cyrillic on an orange bar in the center.
